Engineers possess exceptional ingenuity and are known for their eccentric and marvelous inventions.

SKILLS

GADGETS · SL max 5

When you rest inside a settlement, you gain (SL) Materials. You may use an action and spend Materials to create a Gadget. You can hold up to 10 + (SL × 5) Materials and they never spoil until used.

BREAKTHROUGHS AND MISHAPS · SL max 5

When you create a Gadget, roll a d20. On 1–5, you gain one additional benefit (your choice). On 16–20, one non-creature within 3 squares of you suffers 10 damage and you gain no benefit.

EMERGENCY ITEM · SL max 2

When you would suffer Hit Point or Mind Point loss, you may spend 10 Materials to reduce the loss by (SL × 15).

DISMANTLE · SL max 3

As a reaction to an enemy using an item or a skill that relies on equipment, you may spend 10 Materials. That enemy's attack or Check automatically fails.

QA: Engineer

  • Source: Fabula Ultima: Core Rulebook, pp. 227–230 (printed as TINKERER)
  • Rename: Tinkerer → Engineer (CLASSREF-core-fifteen.md, documented rename, applied silently)
  • Heroics: Numerous via compendium (see HEROICS-compiled.md)
